title: Embedding Poisoning: Bypassing Safety Alignment via Embedding Semantic Shift
reasoning: The paper presents a technical security framework for an adversarial attack (SEP) designed to bypass safety alignment in Large Language Models by perturbing the embedding layer. While safety alignment is an ethical constraint designed to prevent harmful outputs, the research itself is focused on security vulnerabilities and adversarial robustness rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophy.
